Planner: Which pets have arrived for todays routing into the skyports, and are any transfers pending?  
Coordinator: We need immediate confirmation from the terminal screens for the next movement window; Aurelia Skyways will not hold cabin space without this.  
Dispatcher: I am tracking intake clerks, verifying crate seals, and flagging any mismatch between documents and tags before acceptance.  
Handler: The cabin team is standing by to monitor animals during flight; if Mochi boards, I will confirm comfort setup and water access.  
Coordinator: Prioritize transfers that require special attention and keep the chain of custody clean between desks.  
Planner: Ines Moretti and Felix Larsen have recurring traveler notes; ensure the file is ready and the preferred handling instructions are attached.  
Dispatcher: I will reconcile the dispatch ledger, print the routing sheet, and transmit the finalized manifest to the gate lead.  
Handler: If any animal shows stress, report it at once so the team can adjust handling without delay.  
Coordinator: Confirm check-in times with the station liaison and ensure the cabin briefing reflects any recent observations.  
Planner: All pending approvals must be entered before departure, and escalation is to occur immediately if anything stalls.
